# Question: strongest generator shortcut

> For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival rule that fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it disagrees with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your proposed generator emits such cases.

The strongest plausible shortcut is:

**“Fill a blank X-center only when its diagonal color occurs exactly four times in the whole input.”**

It fits every usable canonical demonstration because each answer color there appears as one four-cell diagonal ring. It is stronger and more plausible than a fixed-position rule: global color frequency is easy to infer from all canonical examples and predicts the same labeled centers there.

The exact retained disagreement is `repo/generators/dee38d045bc9/counterexamples/exact_four_occurrence_shortcut.json`, with the authority input copied to `checks/shortcut-counterexample/input.json`. It is a 12×13 generated scene with three valid X-centers at zero-based coordinates `(1,2)`, `(3,11)`, and `(9,7)`. All three diagonal rings use color 6, so color 6 occurs twelve times rather than four. The intended rule fills all three centers with 6; the rival fills none.

I checked the answer through the supported selected-authority command, not only a Python mirror:

```text
cwd: packet_root
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply dee38d045bc9 \
  --input ../checks/shortcut-counterexample/input.json \
  --out ../checks/shortcut-counterexample/racket_output.json
```

`checks/shortcut-counterexample/authority_check.json` binds the result to generator SHA-256 `859652267ce3879e635f8e72d41ec23501a74e9c2240edb8414155fef4e83975` and rule hash `3de95ecac741`; it records that Racket matches the independent intended output and disagrees with the rival.

**Yes, the repaired generator emits such cases.** `color_mode="shared"` deliberately reuses one color across two or three positive centers, independent of the negative-control texture. The task-local regression test covers the exact shortcut, and every one of the 300 final census lessons refuted `fill_colors_occurring_exactly_four_times` in both the lesson competitor and semantic rival declarations.
